stem:
The altitude of an airplane is changing at a constant rate. The table shows the linear relationship between y, the altitude of the airplane in feet, and x, the time in minutes.

Airplane's Altitude

| Time, x (minutes) | Altitude, y (feet) |
|-------------------|--------------------|
| 1.5               | 25,500             |
| 3.25              | 20,250             |
| 6                 | 12,000             |
instruction:
Complete the statement that describes the rate of change of the altitude of the airplane with respect to time.

Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the sentence.
response_template: The altitude of the airplane [blank_1] at a rate of [blank_2] feet per minute.
visual_elements: table with headings Time, x (minutes) and Altitude, y (feet) with values (1.5, 25,500), (3.25, 20,250), (6, 12,000)
notes: Drop-down menus correspond to words describing direction (increasing/decreasing) and numeric rate of change in feet per minute.
